summary: Nano-X Imaging Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of a registered direct offering. The company sold 8,000,000 ordinary shares (or pre-funded warrants) with accompanying ordinary warrants to a single institutional investor at a combined price of $1.00 per unit. Gross proceeds were approximately $8.0 million before fees. Ordinary warrants have a $1.15 exercise price, a five-year term, and a 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners acted as placement agent with a 5.0% fee. Net proceeds will fund working capital. This is a routine capital-raising transaction under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation.
